titleNative: 病弱妹妹总是肖想我
synonyms: My Sickly Sister Always Misses Me
synopsis: Xu Yulian is the eldest daughter of a wealthy family, smart and beautiful. Her life should've been a smooth ride, until she ran into a stumbling block named "Xu Wenjiao." Her sister came out of nowhere and became the person she hates the most. When she was a child, the frail Xu Wenjiao occupied all of her mother's time and attention. After she grew up, Xu Yulian had a crush on the neighbor girl who had just returned from studying abroad. But before she could get up the courage, she saw the girl confess to Xu Wenjiao instead. In this house, it's going to be either her or Xu Wenjiao, one or the other. Xu Yulian got so angry that she actually packed her bags to leave home, but her sister, who always seemed so weak and frail, suddenly grabbed her by the wrist wrist and pushed her into the corner. Xu Wenjiao looked at her jealously and whispered in her ear: "Sister, why do you like her but not me?" Xu Yulian blushed, "Xu Wenjiao, are you crazy? Have you been reading too many bad romance novels to be acting this way?" (Source: Bilibili, translated)

Contrary to Ragna’s expectations, Alicia turns out to be extremely kind. It seems the reason she is cast as a villain isn't due to her character, but for the expediency of the game's story. Can Ragna ward off the malign influences closing in and save Alicia from her ruinous fate?! (Source: One Peace Books)

synopsis: In worlds where card games dominate everything, it's almost a cliché for the fate of the world to hang on the outcome of a card battle. I, Mitsuru Tanefuda, found myself reincarnated into such a world. Thankfully, my dream came true—I became the manager of my very own card shop. In this world, people duel with cards, filled with joy and excitement, and I wanted to watch it all up close. But for some reason, everyone seems to think I'm some legendary hero who solved massive crises in the past, watching over the next generation like a noble predecessor. The truth is, I've never resolved any world-shaking incidents—not even once. This is the story of a reincarnated man who became the manager of a card shop in a world where card games take precedence over everything else. Despite having no great achievements to his name, everyone around him assumes he must have been a hero who once saved the world. (Source: Kadokawa, translated)
